page_title: CHE 4-3 MNU | Chelsea v Manchester Utd 04/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+13' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+12' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is the recipient.
90+11' 4 - 3 Goal! Enzo Fernandez passes the ball to Cole Palmer (Chelsea) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Andre Onana couldn't do anything about it. 4:3.
90+11' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+11' Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Chelsea.
90+10' 3 - 3 Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Andre Onana into the bottom right corner.
90+10' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+10' Referee Jarred Gillett is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Chelsea!
90+9' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Chelsea using VAR. Let's see what happens.
90+7' Dangerous play by Diogo Dalot (Manchester United). Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. Chelsea are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
90+7' The attendance is 39694.
90+7' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
90+5' The ball possession is 56:44.
90+3' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Djordje Petrovic, who smothers the ball.
90+1' The ball is laid off to Noni Madueke (Chelsea) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Andre Onana to make a decent save.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is flagged for offside.
89' A quickly taken corner by Chelsea.
89' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to substitute Conor Gallagher and he is replaced by Noni Madueke (Chelsea).
88' The ball is cleared after Antony (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
86' Alejandro Garnacho comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mason Mount (Manchester United).
85' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
84' Chelsea are seeing far more of the ball now.
83' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 4:13.
81' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes it short.
80' Antony (Manchester United) brings an opponent down and Jarred Gillett interrupts the game.
79' Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar.
78' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
78' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Chelsea.
75' Mauricio Pochettino prepares a substitution. Axel Disasi is replaced by Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea).
75' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea) replaces Malo Gusto.
75' The game has come to an end for Casemiro. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Scott McTominay (Manchester United).
75' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) will take a corner kick.

74' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
73' Corner kicks – 6:3.
71' Here is a change. Moises Caicedo is going off and Mauricio Pochettino gives the last tactical orders to Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea).
71' Substitution. Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) on for Mykhailo Mudryk.
70' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.

67' 2 - 3 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Antony is pounced on by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United). His close-range header flashes past Djordje Petrovic and into the left of the goal. 2:3.
66' Problems for Erik ten Hag as Jonny Evans (Manchester United) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Willy Kambwala replaces him.
66' It will be a substitution. Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is ready to enter the pitch as Rasmus Hojlund walks off.
64' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
61' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
61' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 17:18.
59' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) takes the corner.

59' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Andre Onana, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Chelsea are going to take it.
58' Casemiro (Manchester United) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
58' Corner kick. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is ready to send the ball into the box.
58' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. Manchester Utd win a corner.
57' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
56' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle after Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick is awarded to Chelsea.
55' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
55' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

54' This was a piece of cake for Andre Onana. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
53' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
52' That's unlucky! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
50' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
49' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
48' The opposition can't get near Harry Maguire (Manchester United), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just over the bar at the last second.
48' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Raphael Varane departs the field of play to be replaced by Jonny Evans (Manchester United).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' A great pass puts Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.
45+4' 5:1 – the corner kicks stats.
45+2' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is adjudged offside.
45+1' Chelsea can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

45+1' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Chelsea.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is penalised for a foul. Jarred Gillett had a clear view and blows his whistle.
43' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
42' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.

39' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) makes it 2:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Diogo Dalot and planted his close-range header into the bottom left corner. Djordje Petrovic was helpless.
38' The resulting corner from Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
38' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Andre Onana.
37' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
37' 7:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

34' 2 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 2:1.
33' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is ready and denies him.
32' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.
30' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

30' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.
29' Close! Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
27' Some patient build-up play from Manchester Utd as they look to unlock the defence.

25' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches over the crossbar.
24' Poor challenge! Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is penalised for tripping and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle.
22' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner which is cleared.
22' 46:54 – the ratio of ball possession.
19' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Andre Onana no chance!
19' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is going to take the penalty!
18' Antony (Manchester United) jumps into a tackle and Jarred Gillett signals a foul. PENALTY to Chelsea! Great chance to score.
17' A lofted pass finds Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the right post.
15' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
15' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

15' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
14' Some great controlled play and passing from Chelsea. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
10' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

9' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
7' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home. He has every right to celebrate.
4' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle and signals a foul after Casemiro (Manchester United) brought his opponent down.
2' Antony (Manchester United) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
